ann_latency_pct.real: partial: real per-query ANN latencies (500 queries, standard HNSW, 20,000 real passages, one thread, one run on a loaded Mac); no concurrency or load test; the video still shows LLM-call latencies

ares_ppi.real: partial: no human labels in the pack

answer_correctness.real: partial: claim-level TP/FP/FN hand-labelled by an LLM labeller (one labeller, no human, some arguable labels) on the real answers; cosine from a MiniLM stand-in, not the Ragas embedding model

bertscore.real: partial: token-level greedy matching on 5 real gold/system answer pairs with all-MiniLM-L6-v2 token vectors (a stand-in, NOT roberta-large BERTScore; raw cosines 0.3-0.9, no baseline rescaling); 5 pairs only, no correlation claim

counterfactual_abstention_triplet.real: partial: real masked-gold run on 9 answerable questions (n = 9, one run, LLM judge, 1 reply re-labelled by the agent); abstention 6/9 measured; 'lucky-correct' is an answer leaked through a non-gold passage, not memory; arm A not masked; counterfactual axis is a separate n = 5 run

position_sensitivity.real: partial: own small experiment run (n=10, 5 and 10 passages), curve near ceiling and flat within noise; the U shape of the paper is shown only as a labelled toy

triple_prf.real: partial: real gold labels for 59 triples of 8 passages (LLM-labelled, fully re-read by the agent); recall rests on LLM-proposed missed triples; no human annotator, not a benchmark

entity_resolution_f1.real: partial: real seeded random sample (43 merged pairs census + 120 of a 402-pair blocked pool), labels from an LLM re-read by the agent; recall is an estimate (P 0.977, R about 0.58 [0.43-0.72]), pairs with no shared name words are outside the pool; no human, no kappa

prerequisite_edge_f1.real: partial: precision = one LLM labeller on the pack's 28 'requires' edges (P 0.32 strict); recall now against a BLIND gold list (15 statements, LLM-proposed over 138 passages, read and filtered by the agent, matched to the graph by hand): R 0.20 strict / 0.27 lenient; small, not a benchmark

evidence_triple_recall.real: partial: gold G* = triples labelled correct (strict) or correct+partly (lenient) for 7 of 20 questions (LLM-labelled, agent re-read); LLM-proposed missed triples only lower the ceiling; other 13 questions keep the proxy

subgraph_precision.real: partial: gold = triples labelled correct (strict) or correct+partly (lenient) for 7 of 20 questions (59 triples, LLM-labelled and agent re-read); other 13 questions keep the unlabelled proxy

kgqa_hits_at_k.real: partial: answer nodes still a proxy (lexical candidates + LLM pick, all 20 picks re-read by the agent); n = 12 of 20 answerable questions (was 10); PPR ranks are measured live

kg_groundedness_rate.real: done: claim-vs-KG rule on the real pack (our crude rule, compared with the judges)

stage_latency.real: partial: retrieval stages (query embedding, dense search, BM25, RRF, cross-encoder rerank, graph BFS, PPR) timed locally on the real corpus; generation = the 36 real answer-call latencies; entity linking, embedding through a remote API, time to first token and large-index search not timed

throughput_littles_law.real: done: W = the 36 real answer-call latencies (mean 3.71 s, p95 5.14 s); concurrency needed and throughput ceiling computed live. Queue panel is a labelled SIMULATION (Poisson arrivals, FIFO, service resampled from the 36 values); rate limits and real queueing are not in the pack.

agent_steps.real: partial: a small real search-agent loop (24 questions, 1 tool, one model, one run); not the thesis tutor; no cap was ever reached (FTS 0 at cap 8)

pedagogy_rubric.real: pending: no tutor dialogues or human ratings in the pack

pedagogy_reward_winrate.real: pending: no pedagogy reward model and no tutor-vs-teacher dialogue data in the pack (the answer study is factual QA; its pairwise win rate is an LLM judge between arms, a different measurement)

tutoreval_keypoints.real: partial: real Q&A answers, not tutor dialogues; our rule; real tutor dialogues pending

answer_leakage_rate.real: partial: real Q&A answers, not tutor dialogues; our rule; real tutor dialogues pending

normalized_gain.real: pending: no pre/post data (the classroom study does not exist yet)

cohens_d.real: done: effect sizes of the arm differences on the real per-question scores (n=9, LLM-judged); classroom effect sizes need real students

concept_coverage.real: done: our rule on the real graph, two expected-set definitions
